supersedes: the 472cdf13 anchor-row canary readings -- measured on image covid-mech-v1 under the pre-repair daily_hazard presentation draw and now stale. This amendment re-measures the same canary shape under the shipped once_per_course draw and re-points pairing at the v15 parent surface.
description: Mechanism assay on the THETA-SCREEN residual: a hard non-susceptible fraction of hosts drawn per voyage at initialization -- the effective-susceptible-pool candidate for the measured ~2x+ truth overshoot (takeoff seeds burn ~94% of 3,711 aboard vs the serology-informed truth ~840 / ~22%). The mechanism reuses the shipped secretor-negative grammar verbatim: secretor_negative_fraction + secretor_negative_relative_susceptibility on the sars_cov2_resp profile via pathogen_overrides, so drawn hosts take susceptibility x0 and can neither infect nor shed -- the same zero-draw shape the noro line uses for FUT2 secretor status. The declared sweep {0.25, 0.5, 0.75} resolves the response curve: 0.5 and 0.75 are the SENS-ASSAY-V2 arm labels verbatim (that screen stood down unmeasured at the stale band); 0.25 extends the curve below them. The fractions are assay arms, NOT an adopted constant -- parameter provenance is satisfied by the sweep being read as a response curve against the clause; no value is fitted to the record and none is adopted from this design. The assay replays the v15 stage-2 cell family verbatim at the measured admissible band plus the Theta 1e9 anchor: per (theta, fraction) the takeoff-conditioned recorded_onsets and before_share vectors answer whether a bounded susceptible pool moves the clause outcome class at any admissible Theta.
prerequisites: THETA-SCREEN-V15 measured (6efec855) under the repaired once_per_course presentation draw: admissible band {1.78e11, 2.37e11, 3.16e11, 4.22e11, 5.62e11} -- identical coordinates to the v13 band, so this design's point list stands verbatim; conditional clause FAILS at every admissible Theta (takeoff-seed q05 floors 1,444-1,743 vs the record's 197, before_share medians 0.735-0.957 vs 0.173); PASS only at the Theta 1e9 boundary anchor.

SERO-CHANNEL-V1 measured: the ~18x conditional-size gap factorizes ~2x channel x ~2x+ truth overshoot; truth overshoot is the half a bounded susceptible pool addresses (it bounds truth without flattening takeoff, which LAMBDA-CROSS-V1 showed hazard-rate scaling alone cannot do).

SENS-ASSAY-V2 declared (stood down): the same secretor_negative_fraction grammar at {0.5, 0.75} on the stale band; this design carries those arm labels verbatim so its rows are the same arms at the measured band.

Baseline cells are unaffected by the new draws: secretor_negative_fraction absent or 0 short-circuits the genetics_rng draw (frac > 0 gate in _seed_host_susceptibility), so the declared arm stays byte-paired with the v15 parent rows; arms with f > 0 consume the genetics stream per agent and are their own cohort -- declared, not an accident.
voyage_mode_note: Declared replay, verbatim from covid_theta_screen_v15_stage2 (the same frozen cell family, carried since v11): index onset_day -1.0, departure_day 5.0, dwell_weighted sanitary visits, imports 1, infection_age_days 6.8 (measured null axis carried for cell-key bookkeeping), 20 matched seeds at base 20200205, 768 epochs.
thetas_note: Theta 1e9 anchor (QUAR-ATTR-V2 re-measurement, never a candidate) plus the five v15 admissible interior points verbatim (the same lattice coordinates v13 measured) -- the clause is read as a function of the non-susceptible fraction at fixed admissible Theta, so the response curve carries the mechanism's dose-size interaction.
seeds_note: The same 20 matched seeds as every stage-2 surface since v10 -- seed-for-seed pairing against the v15 stage-2 rows (s3 prefix campaign/covid_theta_screen_v15_stage2/6efec855/cells/).

arms.note: v15 baseline: sars_cov2_resp ships innate_nonsusceptible_fraction 0.0 / no secretor draw -- the whole pool is susceptible; seed-for-seed pairing against the v15 stage-2 surface is the drift audit.
25% hard zero draw (relative susceptibility 0.0): declared extension below the V2 arm grid to resolve the curve downward.
50% hard zero -- SENS-ASSAY-V2 arm label verbatim.
75% hard zero -- SENS-ASSAY-V2 arm label verbatim; the truth-overshoot scale (~94% vs ~22% burn) puts the interesting region near this end.

cells_note: 6 points x 4 arms x 20 seeds = 480 declared-replay cells (~30 min each). Companion design covid_susc_pool_v1_fleet runs the coarse generic-voyage fleet-shape response at the five admissible Thetas, 50 seeds per row, same arms.

admissibility.note: FROZEN before any cell exists. The conditional_trajectory_clause and index_geometry audit invariant are carried verbatim from covid_theta_screen_v15_stage2 (unchanged since the v11 lineage froze them); the verdict grammar is an assay's, not a screen's.

conditional_trajectory_clause.criterion: Verbatim from v15 stage 2 (v11 lineage): among takeoff seeds (recorded_onsets >= 10), the q05-q95 interval of recorded_onsets contains 197 AND median before_share within 0.10 of 0.173; scored only when >= 5 takeoff seeds.
conditional_trajectory_clause.note: Scored per (theta, arm) row. The deliverable beside it: takeoff-seed count, fraction of takeoff seeds with recorded_onsets in [98.5, 394], median and q05-q95 before_share, and the full per-seed vectors -- the response curve across the fraction sweep.

index_geometry.criterion: AUDIT INVARIANT verbatim: index_onset_day == -1.0 and index_shedding_at_day0 true in 100% of every cell's seeds; deviation invalidates the cell.
index_geometry.reads: the seeded host's own onset and shedding record

admissibility.verdict_grammar: Assay verdict, frozen: (a) the clause outcome class per (theta, fraction); (b) the monotone shape of recorded_onsets vs fraction at fixed Theta (the mechanism's signature -- a bounded pool should lower takeoff mass roughly in proportion to susceptible count); (c) whether any fraction moves before_share toward 0.173. A clause PASS inside the sweep triggers a re-screen design on that arm, never an adoption; a flat response across the sweep rules the pool-size mechanism out at the declared geometry.

diagnostics.fleet_shape_indicator: Reported never thresholded, per arm: P(attack <= 0.01), takeoff fraction, P(attack >= 0.10), attack-rate quantiles -- the replay distribution under each fraction.
diagnostics.paired_vs_v15: The declared arm pairs seed-for-seed with covid_theta_screen_v15_stage2 at each Theta on image covid-theta-v15-6efec855 (s3 prefix campaign/covid_theta_screen_v15_stage2/6efec855/cells/) -- the drift audit: a no-override arm must reproduce the parent cells on the current engine; armed rows additionally report per-seed deltas against the declared arm's own row (the mechanism's marginal effect on the same cohort).
diagnostics.pool_spend_readout: Per row: the payload's secretor_negative block echoes declared / resolved / realized draws (fraction of aboard hosts drawn secretor-negative and with susceptibility_multiplier 0 at epoch 0) vs its arm's declared fraction -- wiring proof that the override reached the population; a realized ~0 on an f > 0 arm is a flag-did-not-land defect, not a result.

execution.platform: AWS Batch via deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh with DESIGN=covid_susc_pool_v1, on the same campaign image as covid_ring_cap_v1 (pathogen_overrides is a shipped grammar; no engine change is needed beyond what that image already carries). Convention: submit to the On-Demand queue picard-analysis-queue (CE picard-analysis-compute-ondemand, max 256 vCPU) -- us-east-1 Spot droughts park arrays >1h at RUNNABLE and are not job errors. Image is the thin per-campaign layer deploy/aws/Dockerfile.covid_mech_v2 (FROM picard-campaign + ENTRYPOINT ["python3"]) built on the base image at the merged design-PR SHA.
execution.canary: Theta 1e9 anchor row on all four arms (cell order point x arm x seed: indices 0-79) -- re-measures the stale 472cdf13 canary under once_per_course: wiring proof the override lands (the secretor_negative audit echo shows the declared fraction resolved and realized per arm) plus the audit invariant and non-degeneracy: INDEX_OFFSET 0, ARRAY_SIZE 80. Remaining rows proceed on a clean read per the campaign gate.
execution.report_immediately_if: any cell's audit invariant fails; f050 no longer passes the anchor clause under once_per_course (the assay premise collapses); every row at f075 reports insufficient takeoff mass (the mechanism killed takeoff before bounding it -- a geometry finding); the clause passes only at a boundary endpoint; the response in fraction is non-monotone at two consecutive admissible Thetas (stream-disruption suspicion, not biology); an f-arm's secretor_negative audit echo shows the override did not reach the population; or child failure rate exceeds 5%.
